title: MNI Open iEEG Atlas: normal intracranial EEG in wakefulness and sleep (processed 200 Hz atlas clips)
description: The processed portion of the MNI Open iEEG Atlas, comprising artifact-free intracranial EEG (stereo-EEG and subdural strips/grids) from 106 patients with drug-resistant focal epilepsy. It provides one minute of normal-activity bipolar channels per vigilance state (wakefulness, N2, N3, REM) and up to 10 minutes of N2/N3 sleep, resampled to 200 Hz. Only channels judged to record normal brain activity are included, supporting a normative atlas of intracranial EEG across cortical regions.
methods_description: Intracranial EEG was recorded at three epilepsy centres and selected from channels outside the seizure onset zone and lesions. Source authors applied an 80 Hz low-pass anti-aliasing filter, resampled to 200 Hz, applied adaptive power-line removal (1-min set), performed visual artifact rejection and mean removal, and concatenated artifact-free segments with zero buffers. The arrays were repacked losslessly into BrainVision float32 format with BIDS metadata.
